description: Upload the product buyers get (zip, pdf, epub, docx, xlsx, pptx, txt, md, csv, json, png, jpg, webp, gif, mp3, wav, mp4) as base64 — max 25 MB; for big files use POST /api/files with raw bytes. Returns file_id to pass to create_listing / update_listing.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.
